system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) and Expertise (1) in Arcana

You have learned to quickly unravel arcane energy to unmake spells before they take effect.

When a creature you can see within 30 spaces casts a spell, you can spend 1 Resolve to attempt to counterspell them.

This requires a successful Counteract check using Mind (Arcana).

If you succeed, the spell is countered and has no effect. If you fail, the spell takes effect as normal.

customTrait.name: Counteract
customTrait.description: This ability is specifically for countering spells.
